scientific_question: Does one coarse-resolvable curved-adjoint direction, generated only from deployed observations, add mechanism headroom beyond a paired four-direction search?

prior_evidence_role.v43_result_required_for_claim_context_bu: validated bounded negative for the fixed four-direction truth-aware oracle

forbidden_preseal_payloads: any field, gradient or observation metric other than the deployed observation vector itself

allowed_inputs: frozen curved forward and derivative operator
forbidden_inputs: v41, v42 or v43 selected weights
stage_a_truth_free_candidate_generation.observation_inner_product: ordinary Euclidean inner product over the frozen 2072-vector without whitening or per-view reweighting
arms: the same four directions plus one coarse-resolvable curved-adjoint enrichment
stage_a_truth_free_candidate_generation.candidate_selection: the final accepted trust-region center, starting from zero and accepting only exact curved-objective decreases with the frozen ratio rule
stage_a_truth_free_candidate_generation.preseal_metadata_firewall: do not parse, hash or otherwise read full READY, manifest, checksum or prediction-barrier containers; validate only the frozen private allowed-input release and the files listed in that release

coarse_resolvable_curved_adjoint_enrichm.visible_residual: y minus exact curved prediction at Direct-K3
coarse_resolvable_curved_adjoint_enrichm.raw_high_resolution_descent: exact J_curved(Direct-K3)^T times visible_residual divided by max(||y||^2, 1e-30)
coarse_resolvable_curved_adjoint_enrichm.prolongation: the exact frozen trilinear map P from 16x16x32 coarse corrections to 32x32x64 high corrections
coarse_resolvable_curved_adjoint_enrichm.restriction: the exact Euclidean adjoint P^T of that same prolongation, obtained by reverse-mode differentiation through the identical trilinear interpolation and linear-extrapolation program
coarse_resolvable_curved_adjoint_enrichm.prolongation_adjoint_identity:
for fixed deterministic probes require

and to agree
coarse_resolvable_curved_adjoint_enrichm.physical_l2_adjoint_scale: both grids are uniform and coarse cell volume is eight times high cell volume, so the physical-L2 adjoint is (1/8) P^T
coarse_resolvable_curved_adjoint_enrichm.physical_l2_scale_action: the common 1/8 factor is omitted before fixed direction renormalization because it cannot change the normalized direction; no unnormalized physical-gradient magnitude claim is allowed
coarse_resolvable_curved_adjoint_enrichm.coarse_raw_direction: subtract the unweighted coarse-grid mean from P^T times the gauged high-resolution adjoint
coarse_resolvable_curved_adjoint_enrichm.coarse_projection_inner_product: ordinary Euclidean; the current coarse grid has constant cell volume so this equals physical-L2 up to one common positive factor
coarse_resolvable_curved_adjoint_enrichm.coarse_straight_span: the four unchanged gauged 16x16x32 CGLS increments
coarse_resolvable_curved_adjoint_enrichm.retained_singular_value_rule: retain sigma_i only when sigma_i > 1e-12 times sigma_max
coarse_resolvable_curved_adjoint_enrichm.positive_increment_norm_rule: each norm must exceed 1e-14 times the maximum of the four norms
coarse_resolvable_curved_adjoint_enrichm.coarse_orthogonal_component: (I minus the retained coarse-span projector) times the coarse raw direction, followed by coarse gauge
coarse_resolvable_curved_adjoint_enrichm.orthogonal_energy_fraction_definition: squared coarse-L2 norm of the orthogonal component divided by squared coarse-L2 norm of the coarse raw direction
coarse_resolvable_curved_adjoint_enrichm.high_direction: prolong the coarse orthogonal component with P and subtract the fine-grid mean
coarse_resolvable_curved_adjoint_enrichm.normalization: scale the high direction to the median positive high-resolution L2 norm of P applied to the four original coarse increments
coarse_resolvable_curved_adjoint_enrichm.sign: positive coefficient must have positive inner product with the raw high adjoint and therefore be the local curved-observation descent sign
coarse_resolvable_curved_adjoint_enrichm.degenerate_direction_rule: orthogonal energy below 1e-6 is a valid bounded negative for this raw enrichment, not an implementation failure

representation.four_direction_control: four unchanged prolonged straight-ray CGLS increments
representation.five_direction_candidate: the same four directions plus the normalized coarse-resolvable curved-adjoint direction

paired_observation_only_trust_region.local_model: exact curved center prediction plus one exact JVP per direction
paired_observation_only_trust_region.inner_problem: box-and-L-infinity-trust-region bounded affine observation least squares without truth constraints

per_snapshot_complete_gate: field, gradient, and observation are each at most 1.01 times Direct-K4
field, gradient, and observation are each no worse than Zero
observation is no worse than Direct-K3 plus 1e-12
candidate is not Pareto dominated by Direct-K3
stage_b_post_seal_scoring.aggregate_gate: median field, gradient, and observation are each no worse than the corresponding Direct-K4 median
stage_b_post_seal_scoring.fragile_margin: a witness with minimum margin below 1e-3 to any 1.01 Direct-K4 gate is fragile
stage_b_post_seal_scoring.paired_control_requirement: the four-direction control must fail the complete gate under the same search algorithm, start, box and outer-iteration cap
stage_b_post_seal_scoring.fifth_direction_attribution_ablation: set the selected five-direction candidate's fifth coefficient exactly to zero, rescore exactly, and require at least one previously passing key gate to fail

formal_audits.curved_adjoint_identity_probe: unit-L2 deterministic standard-normal fine-grid probe with unweighted mean removed, NumPy seed 4401
formal_audits.curved_adjoint_identity_relative_error: abs(<J probe, residual> - <probe, raw adjoint>)/max(abs(left), abs(right), 1e-30)

independent_validation.finite_difference_direction: the normalized fifth direction at Direct-K3

decision_rule.robust_mechanism_headroom: all four five-direction candidates and the aggregate gate pass with minimum 1.01 margin at least 1e-3, the paired four-direction control fails, the fifth-coefficient-zero ablation loses at least one key gate, and independent replay agrees
decision_rule.fragile_headroom: the attribution conditions hold and the complete gate passes, but the minimum 1.01 margin is below 1e-3
decision_rule.bounded_negative: the valid paired execution finds no attributable complete-gate advantage for the single coarse-resolvable raw curved-adjoint direction
decision_rule.degenerate_new_direction: orthogonal energy below 1e-6 is a valid bounded negative
decision_rule.inconclusive: stage ordering, seal, basis, prolongation adjoint, VJP, projection, identities, JVP, inner solve, finite checks, exact rescoring, budget, field replay or independent agreement fails

scientific_action.robust_mechanism_headroom: authorize only a separately preregistered observation-visible approximation study for the fifth direction; do not claim deployment, speed or generalization
scientific_action.bounded_negative: stop the single raw coarse-resolvable adjoint direction and test a preregistered preconditioned or multi-direction curved Krylov enrichment
scientific_action.inconclusive: repair only the identified numerical or validation failure
